name: US Weekly Jobless Claims
citation: U.S. Department of Labor, Employment and Training Administration. "ETA 539: Unemployment Insurance Weekly Claims (ar539)." DOL, 2026, oui.doleta.gov/unemploy/claims.asp.
description:
US national weekly initial unemployment-insurance claims (sum of state filings from ETA-539, not seasonally adjusted), with continued claims as a correlated covariate (not a partition of the target). Strong weekly/annual seasonality and holiday distortions; models should derive calendar features from the single shared time index. Application: labor-market nowcasting and staffing/benefits planning.

Covariate glossary:
- initial claims: US initial unemployment-insurance claims, national weekly new filings (count; target).
- continued claims: US continued unemployment-insurance claims / insured unemployment, national weekly (count).
preprocessing: 1. Downloaded from the cited public source (DOL ETA-539) on 2026-07-14.
2. Aligned all variates onto a single shared time index; covariates forward-filled where a release lag left a gap.
3. Long TempusBench layout: one row per variate; a single shared 'timestamps' JSON array of ISO-8601 UTC strings; 'values' a JSON array (missing -> null).
4. Calendar/derived features (week-of-year, holiday flags) are NOT included as columns; a single time index is provided and models derive calendar features from it.
